botcomponent.description: Use when a new, previously unprocessed email lands in the monitored inbox and asks one or more questions. Researches each question strictly against the agent's configured knowledge sources, then sends the original sender a professional HTML reply with a bolded question summary, a detailed sourced answer, and a link to the source used per question, plus a list of any questions that could not be answered and suggested follow-up questions. Do NOT use for emails containing no question, for an email that has already been replied to, or to answer from general or outside knowledge when the configured knowledge sources do not cover the topic.
botcomponent.name: email-question-research-reply
